content.short: Bounce.Tech offers leveraged tokens on crypto, memecoins and stocks without liquidation risk.
content.description: Bounce.Tech packages leverage into tokens that rebalance automatically, so a holder gains leveraged exposure without maintaining a margin position that can be liquidated. It trades crypto, memecoins and equities on Hyperliquid. Leveraged tokens trade decay for simplicity: they cannot be liquidated, but holding them through choppy markets erodes value in ways that surprise people.
content.meta: Leveraged exposure to crypto, memecoins and equities in token form, with no liquidation price.
